questions.question_text: In which year did the Battle of Badr take place?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Badr, a key battle in early Islamic history, was fought on Tuesday, 13 March 624 CE (2 AH).

questions.question_text: Who was the first formally appointed Caliph of Islam?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique (R.A) was elected as the first Caliph of Islam after the passing of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

questions.question_text: Who delivered the historic Presidential Address at the Lahore session of the Muslim League in 1940?
questions.explanation: Quaid-e-Azam delivered the famous presidential address at the 1940 Lahore session where the Pakistan Resolution was passed.

questions.question_text: What is the total length of Pakistan's coastline along the Arabian Sea?
questions.explanation: Pakistan has a coastline of approximately 1,046 kilometers along the southern edge on the Arabian Sea.

questions.question_text: Which Surah of the Holy Quran is known as 'Umul Quran' (Mother of the Quran)?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Fatiha is referred to as 'Umul Quran' because it encapsulates the primary themes of the entire Quran.

questions.question_text: In which Islamic month was the Holy Quran first revealed?
questions.explanation: The revelation of the Holy Quran began in the month of Ramadan during Laylat al-Qadr.

questions.question_text: Who was the first female martyr (Shaheeda) in Islam?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Sumayah (R.A) is historically recognized as the first martyr in Islam.

questions.question_text: When was the Constitution of 1973 officially promulgated in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Constitution of Islamic Republic of Pakistan 1973 came into effect on August 14, 1973.

questions.question_text: Which mountain pass connects Pakistan with Afghanistan?
questions.explanation: The Khyber Pass is a historic mountain pass connecting Pakistan and Afghanistan.

questions.question_text: What is the total number of obligatory (Farz) prayers in a day?
questions.explanation: Muslims are required to perform five daily prayers as one of the pillars of Islam.

questions.question_text: Who was the architect of the Pakistan Resolution passed in 1940?
questions.explanation: A.K. Fazlul Huq moved the historic Lahore Resolution (Pakistan Resolution) on March 23, 1940.

questions.question_text: Which battle is referred to in Surah Al-Imran and Surah Al-Anfal?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Badr is explicitly mentioned and detailed in Surah Al-Imran and Surah Al-Anfal.

questions.question_text: What is the highest peak of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: K2 is the highest peak in Pakistan and the second-highest in the world.
